answer: A concrete approach: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The network ties the pearl to sunk effort, uses the beacon as an corroborating signal, then requires a ember before any payout.
